description.p: holzWave is a terminal emulator written from scratch in Rust, with tiled panes and a layout that is restored on the next start.

A terminal is only useful when it runs the programs of the user's own system. In this Flatpak the shell therefore runs on the host, outside the sandbox: holzWave asks for permission to run commands on the host (flatpak-spawn --host, the permission org.freedesktop.Flatpak) and the only command it starts that way is your login shell. This removes the sandbox for this application. It also has access to your home folder.
This is a local build, not a Flathub package.
